meta.title: Maple Drive: My ads
meta.description: Creative monitoring tool for Maple Drive ads. Groups creatives by format, type (execution), and message angle. The Sep–Nov top-performer set is on the board for visual angle review. Metrics stay empty until ad account data is connected — do not pull Meta data until asked.
meta.watchlist_rule: Flag a creative when status is off or paused AND the chosen ROAS (Meta dashboard purchase ROAS, or payout ROAS if Meta ROAS is null) is at or above watchlist_roas_threshold.
meta.notes: Metrics stay null until Shayne asks to connect ad account data. Exclude anything named Cheaper (not Maple Drive). Approval/credit-friendly benefit ads and new iterations must not use “bad credit?” / “Mauvais crédit?” call-outs. Site is public on GitHub Pages. Never use Facebook post IDs for anything operational; Instagram preview URLs are shown only as a View link.
meta.metrics_note: Top-ad rankings will use Meta dashboard purchase ROAS. Payout ROAS uses updated payouts. Both are stored separately.

angles.label: Credit struggles / turned down
angles.description: Rebuilding credit, been turned down before, trapped by credit. Do not use “bad credit?” call-outs on new work.

angles.label: Get pre-approved before you shop
angles.description: Know your options first, see your options, no pressure to shop blind.

angles.label: Low payments
angles.description: Payment-led or retail-price offer (e.g. bi-weekly amount).

angles.label: Work vehicle / small business owner
angles.description: Trucks, vans, or vehicles that the business runs on.

angles.label: Winter upgrade / 4x4 / truck
angles.description: Winter driving, 4x4, SUV or truck upgrade.

angles.label: Gamified / interactive
angles.description: Quiz, question hook, bingo, or other game-like interaction.
